loops.minute_1: Click big cookie for +1 cookie feedback; first building cost (10 cookies) reached in ~10 clicks; particle effects + floating numbers establish active engagement
loops.minute_10: First buildings (cursor, grandma) generate autonomous production; CPS exceeds manual click rate; first multiplier upgrades acquired; transition from active to idle play begins
loops.hour_5: Production generates 1M+ cookies; ascension (prestige reset) becomes accessible; strategic choice between continuing or resetting for heavenly chips; wrinklers add tactical management layer
loops.endgame: Infinite prestige cycles with 637+ achievements as soft goals; Grandmapocalypse lore, seasonal events, sugar lumps, minigames (Farm, Bank) provide variety; no traditional win condition

objectives.player_goal: Maximize cookie production per second through upgrades and buildings; earn heavenly chips via prestige resets to unlock permanent multipliers; collect all 637+ achievements; explore Grandmapocalypse storyline and seasonal events

games.retention_answer: Ladder-climbing effect from prestige cycles creates long-term satisfaction; exponential growth feels progressively more powerful; achievement milestones provide structure and 20%+ retention uplift from audio/visual feedback (chimes, particles, color ramps); events prevent stagnation. Monotony risk: beyond 2-3 hours, repeated tapping fatigues without new mechanics; managed via prestige gates and achievement variety. Visual conventions: explosive gold particles on milestone hits, sprite size/color escalation reflects progression, satisfying click sound (50ms latency). Audio: chime at each major unlock, upgrade purchase SFX, silence periods punish perceived lag.

loops.minute_1: Place food + select one toy in yard; exit game; UI communicates collection mechanic with minimal onboarding; anticipation begins
loops.minute_10: Return to check yard; 1-3 cats have visited; photograph each cat (memento collection); collect fish currency reward; understand feedback loop: frequency of visits correlates with setup variety
loops.hour_5: Long gaps between sessions generate anticipation and reward delayed gratification; rare cats (26/66) require specific toy+food combinations; trial-and-error layout optimization drives re-engagement and layout diversity
loops.endgame: Collect all 66 cats and their mementos; game continues indefinitely if food/toys maintained; no terminal condition; soft completion goal (all cats) provides endgame arc but not mandatory

objectives.player_goal: Collect all 66 cats (26 rare variants) by arranging toys and food optimally; receive unique memento gift from each cat; achieve 100% completion of photo album and memento checklist

games.retention_answer: Offline progression (cats visit autonomously) rewards patience; collection dopamine from tangible memento rewards (physical gift ≠ abstract currency); cute anthropomorphic aesthetic provides emotional attachment; low friction (5-minute sessions suffice); zero failure state = zen gardening appeal. Monotony risk: after 20-30 cats, cycle becomes predictable (same toys attract same cats); rare cats provide final retention hook but fragile if cat-toy matching becomes transparent. Visual conventions: minimalist UI (no clutter), cute sprite animations (sleeping, playing with toys), subtle color palette supporting calm UX. Audio: soft click, tinkling chime when cat arrives, predominantly silence (intentional zen design). Retention measured by: session frequency (check gaps), collection completion rate, memento acquisition pacing; FOMO absent (no time limits, no penalties).

loops.minute_1: Purchase lemonade stand; generates $0.01/sec passively; first upgrade (Little Umbrellas) multiplies profit ×3; first manager purchase available
loops.minute_10: Operate 3-5 businesses simultaneously (pizza, car wash, farm); hire managers to eliminate manual tapping; income scales exponentially; upgrade costs exceed revenues by 100×; strategic choice between vertical (farm local business) and horizontal (unlock new business) expansion
loops.hour_5: Angel Investors prestige system unlocked; reset accumulated wealth for permanent 5-10% income multiplier; optimal prestige timing becomes meta-strategic; offline progression accumulates revenue passively
loops.endgame: Infinite angel investor multiplier stacking; solo business empire expansion across planets (Earth, Moon, Venus, Mars); each planet resets but carries multiplier bonuses; no cap or win condition; planetary prestige trees create 3-5 distinct progression arcs

objectives.player_goal: Build global business empire by acquiring and upgrading revenue-generating enterprises; optimize angel investor prestige-reset timing for maximum long-term multiplier; expand across planets to unlock new business types and prestige trees

games.retention_answer: Economic gratification (net worth escalation feels powerful); prestige resets create power fantasy (lose short-term progress, gain exponential long-term advantage); offline wealth accumulation rewards patience and login cadence. Monotony risk: without events/narrative, becomes pure spreadsheet optimization after 8-10 hours; planetary progression and manager character humor partially mitigate. Visual conventions: ticker-tape UI (stock prices, income bars), manager portrait gallery (character-driven), large number displays emphasize wealth. Audio: cashier register chimes at major milestones, upgrade purchase SFX, manager voicelines (personality injection). Retention measured by: prestige-reset frequency, angel investor optimization rate, planetary unlock pace; FOMO soft (events, limited-time planets drive login cadence).
